changed: When another device runs a newer version of the app, Device Sync no longer skips records that carry details this version doesn't know about. It keeps those details, syncs the records, and shares them back unchanged, so editing a record on this device no longer loses what the newer version added. A notice lists these records as information. The only records still waiting for an update are dances whose figures a newer version changed; the update notice now marks them as having figures only a newer version can read.
data_migrations: Adds a table that holds details from newer app versions alongside the records they belong to (schema v39).

added: partitionInboundRecordBody and mergeRetainedFields split an inbound body into the part this build syncs and the parts it keeps for a newer version, and put them back; the retained_sync_fields table (schema v39) stores them, and every local body builder re-emits them.
SyncReportCode.newerFigures and SyncReportCode.keptNewerFields; figureJsonKeys and unsupportedFigurePath.
changed: SyncRecordBlob accepts a body carrying fields this build does not classify shareable, refusing (SyncNewerFieldException) only a part it cannot put back exactly. The apply overlay writes only the synced part. A tie on updatedAt that differs only in kept parts is reported, not settled.
